biggest_catch: Your friend must complete one of three specific qualifying paths (Rewards Checking with $500 direct deposit + activity, $7,500 Money Market for 60 days, or a $10,000+ loan) within 60 days.
catches: Both you and your friend each receive a $50 Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral.

Three qualifying paths: (1) friend opens Rewards Checking and within 60 days completes a $500+ direct deposit, 10 checking transactions, eStatements enrollment, and one mobile/online banking login; (2) friend opens a Money Market and maintains $7,500+ for the first 60 days; (3) friend opens a $10,000+ loan, qualified 60 days after opening with good standing and on-time payments.
You must register and the friend must register via your personal referral link.
Reward card mailed approximately 4-6 weeks after conditions are met.
Official page says 'The more friends you refer, the more you can earn!' - no referral cap stated.
Rewards reported to the IRS; program may be changed or discontinued at any time.
